name: dsh-workspace-changes
description: DSH web plugin: an IDE-style Changes panel in the right Sidebar — grouped working-tree changes (JetBrains-style Changes/Unversioned groups, directory tree) with a full diff viewer (unified/side-by-side, line numbers, file navigation), copy-diff, and open-in-IDE. Read-only against the repository.

scripts.test: node --test test/status-parse.test.mjs test/diff-parse.test.mjs test/routes.test.mjs test/http-e2e.test.mjs test/editors.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs
